name: Piyoko
source:
Piyoko  is a girl who attends Magic Academy with the protagonist. She is the younger sister of Bell, a teacher at the Magic Academy. For some reason the sisters took in the protagonist to live in their house.
Piyoko specializes in wind magic and is able to fly a broom, often speeding recklessly while riding it.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=4120]Getchu[/url].]
